notes: STUArray Int Word8 keeps one byte per flag; an STUArray of Bool would be bit-packed, which the rules forbid.
Crossing off and the outer loop are strict tail-recursive loops in ST over 64-bit Int indices, with the bounds-checked readArray/writeArray.
runSTUArray freezes the flags without copying; the scan is a foldl' over a record with strict fields (count, Word64 sum, largest).
ghc -O2 with the non-threaded RTS; fully static (glibc, GMP) and stripped, on a scratch image.
